title: What’s Pulling the Strings? Evaluating Integrity and Attribution in AI Training and Inference through Concept Shift

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting text-to-image models with generic daily life objects (e.g., 'laptop', 'cola') and measuring the frequency of specific brand logos generated in the output, then comparing these frequencies to the actual market share of the brands to quantify covert advertising.

Generating meme variants using stereotype keywords associated with specific societies (e.g., Mexican, Chinese) via DreamBooth, and using the ConceptLens framework to calculate a composite 'Bias Score' that quantifies and localizes sociological symbols using linear feature similarity and Grad-CAM attention maps.
